name: Lovable
shortDescription: GPT Engineer powered full-stack web development agent that creates interactive web applications from prompt descriptions.
description: Lovable (formerly GPT Engineer) is an autonomous full-stack web application builder created to turn natural language specifications into deployment-ready full-stack software. It supports frontend React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and Supabase backend integrations, providing live code previews, automated GitHub synchronization, and one-click cloud hosting.

pricing.details: Free tier available with daily message allocations; paid monthly plans offer expanded message limits, private projects, and GitHub repository integration.

features: Natural language to full-stack web application scaffold and generation
Integrated live visual sandbox preview with real-time hot reloading
Automated backend integration supporting Supabase database tables and auth
Seamless GitHub repository export and bi-directional code syncing
useCases: Rapid prototyping of web MVPs, SaaS landing pages, and React web apps
Converting UI designs and natural language specs into production-ready frontend code
limitations: Free plan message quotas are limited for large iterative development workflows
Complex non-web backend architectures require external API integrations or manual code export

seo.title: Lovable — Autonomous AI Full-Stack Web Application Builder
seo.description: Build, iterate, and deploy full-stack web applications from natural language prompts using Lovable. Explore key features, pricing, and capabilities.
